name: Undertaking Issuance Message
definition: Contents of the related UndertakingIssuance message or of the related issuance document.

UndertakingDetails.name: Undertaking Details
UndertakingDetails.definition: Independent undertaking, such as a demand guarantee or standby letter of credit, that provides financial assurance, to be collected on the presentation of documents that comply with its terms and conditions.

DigitalSignature.name: Digital Signature
DigitalSignature.definition: Digital signature of the issued undertaking.
